user.title: Set up Monitor Treni
user.description: This creates a single hub. Trains to monitor are added and removed from the Lovelace card, not from here.

date.name: Date
date.description: Service date (departure day). Defaults to today if omitted.

date.name: Date
date.description: Service date of the train to remove.

notify_on_delay.name: Notify me if the train is delayed
notify_on_delay.description: Enables a watch for the whole trip: the value given is used as a recurring step (e.g. 15 minutes: alert at 15, 30, 45, 60...), both rising and falling, until the train arrives or the watch is cancelled. Adds the train automatically if not already monitored.

date.name: Date
date.description: Service date (departure day). Defaults to today if omitted.

threshold_minutes.name: Step (minutes)
threshold_minutes.description: How many minutes of delay between each alert.

notify_target.name: Notify target
notify_target.description: The notify entity to send the alert to (e.g. your phone).

cancel_delay_watch.name: Cancel delay watch
cancel_delay_watch.description: Cancels a previously set delay watch, if it hasn't fired yet.
